subject: RE: Post-call: HIPAA / BAA eligibility and deployment options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: HIPAA / BAA eligibility and next steps

Hi Elena

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery:

- HIPAA scope: You confirmed HealthTech AI will be sending PHI to inference endpoints for clinical note summarization and triage flags.
- Primary ask: Confirm whether Redwood can provide a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) and clarify which deployment modes are eligible for PHI (hosted API, Dedicated / reserved capacity, Private VPC/on-prem).
- Compliance artifacts requested: SOC 2 report (summary ok), data residency and access control details, and completion of our vendor security questionnaire.

Next steps I propose:
1) I will attach a draft BAA and a short SOC 2 summary we can share with your security/compliance team.
2) I'll kick off a vendor security questionnaire (xlsx) for you to complete

Will you confirm the right contact?
3) If you need PHI support in production, the eligible deployment options are: Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) and Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem). Our hosted multitenant API can be used for non-PHI workloads only.

Ask: Can you confirm: (a) the person who will own the questionnaire, and (b) whether production PHI will need on-prem or if a Dedicated offering in a customer VPC is acceptable?

I've cc'd Dylan (our solutions lead) to coordinate the questionnaire handoff.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_BAA_Draft.pdf (PDF, 120KB), Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf (PDF, 85KB)

Hi Marissa

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Security contact: please send the questionnaire to me and I'll loop in our security ops lead (Jacob Lee) to complete it.
- PHI boundary: Our intent is to send identifiable patient notes for summarization, so we will need a BAA in place before production.
- Deployment preference: We prefer Dedicated (customer-dedicated instances in our cloud account) if possible; on-prem is an option but we'd prefer to avoid the heavier ops lift.

Could you confirm whether Redwood Dedicated supports customer-managed VPC/network peering and KMS integration for key management? Also, can you share a high-level statement of how PHI is protected in transit and at rest?

Elena
VP Product, HealthTech AI
elena@healthtech.ai

Hi Elena

Quick answers to your questions:

- Redwood Dedicated: supports customer-managed VPC deployments and VPC peering in major cloud providers (AWS/GCP/Azure). We also support bringing your own KMS via customer-managed keys for encryption at rest. I'll include a short doc we use for network setup.
- PHI protections: TLS 1.2+ in transit; at rest we use AES-256 with customer-managed KMS options for Dedicated/Private. Access to keys and logs is restricted to customer-allowed principals; we provide audit logs and can connect to your SIEM.

I've attached the HealthTech_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx. Elena, once you share the contact we'll send a version with embedded guidance.

Next steps:
- Marissa: share BAA draft and SOC 2 summary (done).
- Elena/Jacob: review questionnaire and mark any blockers.
- We'll follow up with an architecture call if Dedicated/VPC connectivity is required.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.com

Hi Elena and Jacob

Thanks, I've attached a signed draft BAA (redlines welcome) and a one-page SOC 2 summary for your security team. Quick notes and proposed timeline:

- BAA: Redwood is willing to sign a standard BAA for PHI handling. The draft outlines responsibilities, permitted uses, and security controls. Please review and send redlines; we can route legal review for small changes.
- Deployment modes for PHI:
  * Redwood Dedicated (recommended): supports customer-managed VPC peering, KMS, and audit log integrations. Suitable for production PHI with our SLA-backed Dedicated offering.
  * Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem): available for customers needing full on-prem air-gapped deployments; this is typically a longer engagement.
  * Hosted API (multitenant): not eligible for PHI.

- SOC 2: see attached summary. For the full SOC 2 report we can initiate an NDA and provide restricted access; please indicate if your security team needs the full report.

Proposed next steps:
1) Elena/Jacob: confirm who will own the questionnaire and target to return within 1 week.
2) We'll schedule a technical architecture call (30-45 min) with your infra team to confirm VPC peering and KMS requirements; would next Tue or Wed work?
3) Legal: send any BAA redlines via DocuSign link below or as tracked changes on the PDF.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link-placeholder
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/HTAI-2026-052
